losses.reason: double-submit XSRF-TOKEN cookie without __Host- prefix (no secure transport): plantable over HTTP or from a sibling subdomain; forgery still needs the X-XSRF-TOKEN header, which a cross-site page cannot send without a CORS preflight
a layout fragment is emitted as a component but no emitted file mounts it; the legacy template included it on its pages
the legacy login passed newAuthentication(false): an already logged-in caller who resubmitted the form kept the current identity; the emitted login authenticates the submitted credentials again
the legacy remember-me store keeps a digest of the token in tokenHash and looks up the raw token by it, so a returned cookie never matches a stored login token
the finder `findByLoginToken` runs createNativeQuery on `User.byLoginTokens`, the name of a named query, which is not SQL
the legacy page loaded this stylesheet for itself only; index.html loads it for every route
